title: Life emerges as Gods fade away

top_liked.author: @leelee1921
top_liked.text: Wow my life changed so much. I am able to learn about so many things that I thought was demonic and as a result, was scared to delve into fearing I might get possessed or harassed by demons. Learned to love myself and understand my humanity. Life became more embracing and I stop…

top_liked.author: @scottsmith2235
top_liked.text: Same for me—no more magical beings in my life. If something good happened, it was God. Something bad, it was the devil. Occasionally an angel might do something.  Now that the ghosts are gone I can concentrate on the realities of life.

top_liked.author: @kylaluv8453
top_liked.text:
The lack of god means the complete absence of sin.  Which means I had to examine my core self, my innate and natural instincts.  Then look around at all of humanity.
What I noticed was we are just basic herd/hive animals.

Do we not mark our territory with boarders and fenses…

top_liked.author: @ThePew-Breaker
top_liked.text: Magical beings are simply an unneeded source of additional stress.

top_liked.author: @yourgodismean4526
top_liked.text: Same! When I left gods and woo, I fell in love with my fellow humans. We are so fascinating, kind, good-weird and endlessly entertaining. I feel an attachment to humanity now that I never experienced as a believer. I’m a lesbian so I always had to hide my real self from fellow…

top_liked.author: @al4nmcintyre
top_liked.text: It's kind of sad to look back at the tiny, constrained world my mind was in as a fundamentalist theist, but it really helps me appreciate life now. It's so much more interesting without the blinders on.

top_liked.author: @Eyesopeningheartrealigning
top_liked.text: Beautiful and yes the natural explanations are very interesting and helpful. Listening to River out of Eden by Richard Dawkins that helps me understand the missing questions I had about the different species and it makes SO MUCH MORE SENSE 🎉

top_liked.author: @thunderbird3694
top_liked.text: The only Hell is what religions create in real life and the only Demons are the imposition of their Beliefs upon others

top_liked.author: @FaithIsNotEvidence
top_liked.text: I am in agreement with you. Once that magical thinking was gone. I truly felt free in my thinking and decision making process for my life. Best thing I did for me was to become actually free indeed!
